messages:
mila-chen: quick ping — opened PR #4823 to clean up exports and move a couple small helper utils out of core runtime. Mostly whitespace + rename, but touches serializer and config loader. can someone take a quick look? should be low risk, but want to avoid breaking import paths :grimacing:
jake-w: on it, will skim in the next 30m. any particular files you want eyes on?
sarah-ng: +1 i'll check serializer changes, want to make sure no behavioural regressions for streaming paths. link?
mila-chen: thanks — https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/4823
small note: run `./dev/run-unit --packages runtime serializer` to reproduce local tests.
lint-bot: PR #4823 — style checks: 2 warnings (trailing-comma, max-line-length), 0 errors. CI job: linters/pylint failed on serializer/compat.py:42

alex-r: I can look at the import restructuring. if it's just moving `utils` into `runtime/utils` we should keep the old compatibility shim for one release. can you add a short deprecation comment?
mila-chen: good call — I'll add a shim and a comment + a tiny test for the shim behavior.
jake-w: saw one oddness in the diff: serializer/compat.py still imports `core.utils` in one place — that's probably causing CI lint. easy fix to update path or add shim.
sarah-ng: code-wise looks fine other than that. pls add a changelog note (internal) for the exports change so infra teams are aware.
mila-chen: pushing fix now, will update tests and add the shim + changelog entry.
lint-bot: PR #4823 — style checks: 0 warnings, 0 errors. CI: all checks passed ✅
jake-w: LGTM :+1: small nit about a comment but not blocking.
sarah-ng: approved — left one inline about docstring wording, non-blocking.
deploy-bot: merged PR #4823 into main at 1782502105 by mila-chen.
mila-chen: thanks all! will monitor canaries for the next hour, ping if anything odd appears :pray:
